newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen signs $7.35 mln wireless deal with Motorola.
newsitem.headline: Yemen signs $7.35 mln wireless deal with Motorola.

text.p: Yemen's telecommunications company TeleYemen on Sunday said it had awarded the U.S. company Motorola a $7.35 million contract to install a wireless telephone service.
"Motorola will start installing a wireless loob system with a 5,000 line capacity in the first quarter of 1997," Abdullah al-Hamami, undersecretary at Yemen's ministry of communications told Reuters.
He said the system will initially provide 500 lines that will mainly serve investment companies and the business sector in Aden's free zone, in southern Yemen.
Yemen earlier this year awarded France's Alcatel two contracts worth $53 million to improve the country's telephone network.
